correctness.rationale: The finite-tree median separates three branches, giving an exact third centered-moment factorization whose nonzero parity-fixed edge factors reduce sign reversals to positive roots of B_o-A_o. A constructive rooted unlabelled tree multiset recurrence is exhaustive; for every one of 4765 possible median-root types through twelve vertices, Descartes gives at most one positive root except two eleven-vertex polynomials whose exact rational Sturm counts are zero. A thirteen-site tree has root-conditioned polynomials A=(1,12,56,129,153,86,17,1), B=(0,1,10,40,80,80,32); difference has two Descartes sign changes and separate sign crossings between 3-4 and 14-15, ensuring exactly two simple positive roots. Exact independent-set enumeration separately checks 8192 subsets and triples at fugacities 1,4,15. No infinite-order theorem is inferred from finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The minimal size at which three-point connected correlation reverses twice is a natural sharp boundary in a standard equilibrium hard-core tree model. In contrast, all two-point covariance signs are fixed by graph-distance parity. An exact first-order cutoff and finite explicit counterexample show where higher-order response becomes genuinely reentrant, offering a focused benchmark for nonmonotonic correlations without invoking a thermodynamic transition.
